Notes to the Unaudited Consolidated Statements of Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026:

1. The above unaudited Consolidated Financial Results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Holding Company at the meeting held on 20/11/2026. The Statutory Auditors have carried out the limited review of the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30,2026 vide their report dated 20/11/2026.

2. This result has been prepared in accordance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirement) Regulation, 2015. The material accounting policies applied in preparation of these financial results are consistent with those followed in the annual consolidated financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.

3. Specific notes related with Subsidiary Companies:

a) Loss of Control over Subsidiaries, Reclassification of Investment as Associate and Change in Basis of Consolidation

i. Disposal of Stake in Valecha Infrastructure Limited (VIL)
During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Holding Company completed the divestment of its investment in 42,000 equity shares of VIL for an aggregate consideration of Rs.4.20 lakh, which was received in full on June 30, 2026. The transfer of shares was executed in two tranches through the Holding Company's demat account, comprising 28,000 equity shares on July 1, 2026 and the remaining 14,000 equity shares on September 11, 2026.

ii. Impact on Valecha Badwani Sendhwa Tollways Limited (VBSTL)

Upon completion of the transfer of the remaining shares on September 11, 2026, the Holding Company's equity holding in VIL stood reduced to 16%. Consequently, the Holding Company ceased to have control over VIL and VIL ceased to be a subsidiary of the Holding Company with effect from September 11, 2026. Accordingly, VBSTL, in which VIL held 74% equity stake, also ceased to be a step-down subsidiary of the Holding Company from the same date.


iii. Impact on Valecha Reality Limited (VRL)

Valecha Reality Limited (VRL), in which the Holding Company and VIL held 49.90% equity stake each, was considered a subsidiary of the Holding Company prior to the aforesaid divestment, considering the control exercised by the Holding Company through its direct and indirect shareholding. Consequent to the loss of control over VIL, VRL also ceased to be a subsidiary of the Holding Company with effect from September 11, 2026. However, the Holding Company continues to exercise significant influence over VRL through its direct equity holding of 49.90%. Accordingly, the investment in VRL has been reclassified from investment in subsidiary to investment in associate with effect from September 11, 2026.

The Company has recognised an aggregate gain of Rs. 323.48 crores on loss of control in the Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss under "Exceptional Items (Net) [Gain/(Loss)]", comprising Rs. 286.93 crores in respect of VIL, Rs. 26.28 crores in respect of VBSTL and Rs. 6.81 crores in respect of VRL. The gain has been recognised upon derecognition of the respective assets and liabilities and accounting for the retained investments in accordance with the applicable Indian Accounting Standards. The computation also considers the reversal of non-controlling interest (minority interest) of Rs. 0.26 crores in respect of VBSTL, while an amount of Rs. 3.72 crores has been adjusted against Other Equity.

The Exceptional Items (Net) [gain/(loss)] of Rs.323.48 includes:-

Sr. No. Particulars Gain / (loss) Rs. in Crore
1 Gain on account of loss of control in two subsidiaries and one step-down subsidiary as explained in note 3 a) iii. 320.02
2 Reversal of Minority interest on derecognition of VBSTL (0.26)
3 Adjustment in “Other Equity” on account of derecognition of Subsidiary, Step-down subsidiary including erstwhile step-down subsidiary 3.72
Total 323.48

iv. Valecha L M Toll Private Limited (VLMTPL), an erstwhile step-down subsidiary of the Holding Company, was admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) pursuant to the order of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) dated 29 March 2019 and subsequently ordered into liquidation on 27th October 2020. Consequent upon the loss of control, VLMTPL was derecognised from the consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2021, and the resultant gain was recognised under Exceptional Items.
During the course of review of historical consolidation records pertaining to the pre-CIRP period, the Management has identified certain matters requiring further evaluation, particularly relating to the treatment of accumulated losses attributable to non-controlling interests and their consequential impact on the gain recognised upon loss of control.
The Management is in the process of evaluating and reconciling the aforesaid historical consolidation adjustments. Pending completion of the assessment, the consequential financial impact, if any, has not yet been reliably determined and, accordingly, no adjustment has been incorporated in the accompanying unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026.

b) Valecha Kachchh Toll Roads Limited (VKTRL)

i. Hon'ble, NCLT, Mumbai, passed Order dated 09.10.2023 in Company Petition no. CP (IB) 360(MB)/2023 filed by Canara Bank, the Financial Creditor /Petitioner, under section 7 of Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (I&B Code) against Valecha Kachchh Toll Roads Limited (VKTRL), Corporate Debtor, for initiating Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP).

Mr. Avil Jerome Menezes, a Registered Insolvency Professional having Registration Number [IBBI/IPA-001/IPP00017/2016-17/10041] has been appointed as Interim Resolution Professional (IRP)(later on confirmed as RP by Committee of Creditors (CoC)), to carry out the functions as mentioned under Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC,2016)for running the CIRP of the Company. Further pursuant to Section 30(4) of IBC, 2016, Resolution plan for revival of the company, submitted by Resolution Applicant has been approved by CoC of VKTRL in the CoC meeting held on 28th March 2025 with the requisite majority. Application for approval of Resolution Plan {IA(IBC)(PLAN)/61/MB/2025} has been filed on 09th May, 2025 with the Hon’ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench and is currently pending adjudication.

In view of the above fact that the Resolution plan is yet to be approved by NCLT and moreover, as per provisions of IBC, 2016, the company is to be kept as a going concern, and hence unaudited financial results are prepared assuming that it will continue as a going concern.

ii. The Resolution plan is yet to be approved by NCLT due to which, the Ind AS 109 – Financial Instruments compliance relating to the recognition and derecognition of financial assets and liabilities is not yet done. Consequently, the impact, if any, arising from such recognition and derecognition has not been determined or given effect in the unaudited financial results. The same will be considered and accounted for upon conclusion of the CIRP and final approval of the Resolution Plan by the Hon’ble NCLT.

c) Valecha International (FZE)
The financial statements of Valecha International FZE have been translated using the exchange rate as of March 31, 2023, instead of the applicable exchange rate as of September 30, 2026.

d) Professional Realtors Private Limited (PRPL)
The Company has incurred continuous losses during the current and previous financial years and, as at September 30, 2026. Further, the Company has experienced adverse financial conditions which indicate the existence of a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
Based on the management’s assessment and considering the absence of future plans for revival of operations and generation of sufficient cash flows, the financial statements have not been prepared on a going concern assumption. Accordingly, the assets of the Company have been stated at realizable value.

5 Valecha Reality Limited Subsidiary Company (up to September 11, 2026) Associate Company ( w.e.f. September 11, 2026)
6 Valecha Badwani Sendhwa Tollways Limited Step-Down Subsidiary Company (up to September 11, 2026)
7 UV Bharat Private Limited Subsidiary Company (w.e.f. 1st April 2026)





5. Capital Reserve and Assessment of Pre-CIRP Assets Pursuant to Implementation of the Resolution Plan :
Capital Reserve has arisen pursuant to the implementation of the approved Resolution Plan of Holding company under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, representing the surplus arising on account of extinguishment and settlement of liabilities of financial creditors in accordance with the terms of the approved Resolution Plan.
Pursuant to the implementation of the approved Resolution Plan, the Holding Company has undertaken a comprehensive review of certain assets and liabilities, including trade receivables, loans, advances, deposits and other balances, substantially pertaining to the period prior to the commencement of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The assessment involved review of underlying records, legal status, recovery efforts, confirmations, litigations and other available information.
Based on such assessment, wherever management concluded that there was no reasonable expectation of recovery or settlement, appropriate adjustments have been recognised in the financial results. Balances for which the recoverability assessment is not yet concluded continue to be carried at their respective carrying values, subject to ongoing review and evaluation. The Holding Company shall recognise further adjustments, if any, in the period in which additional information becomes available or the assessment is concluded.
During the quarter ended 30th June, 2026, pursuant to the ongoing realisability assessment of assets and liabilities, the Holding Company has written back statutory dues payable amounting to Rs.0.01 crores through Capital Reserve, as such balances pertained to the period prior to the approval of Resolution Plan and are no longer considered payable.
